shots.name: landing
shots.caption: The front door
shots.note: Two ways in, one per role. Nobody logs in: this is a demo build and identity is chosen here instead.

shots.name: manager-overview
shots.caption: Manager console, as Marta
shots.note: The radar compares practice against the floor. The queue is what the agent has drafted and is holding.

shots.name: verify-queue
shots.caption: The verify queue
shots.note: Every card is one recommendation about one person. Abstentions are shown too, rather than hidden.

shots.name: verify-detail
shots.caption: One recommendation, opened
shots.note: The claim, the evidence behind each part of it, and the three verdicts. Nothing routes anywhere until one is chosen.

shots.name: transfer-gap
shots.caption: The transfer gap, per person
shots.note: The product in one screen. Strong in practice and weak on the floor is BLOCKED, and more training will not fix it.

shots.name: team-insights
shots.caption: Team patterns
shots.note: Only patterns shared by five or more people are shown. The count of what was withheld is displayed rather than quietly dropped.

shots.name: log-observation
shots.caption: Logging what the manager saw
shots.note: This is the gate. Until this is submitted for a person, their practice scores stay hidden from the manager.

shots.name: staff-home
shots.caption: The staff app, as Diego
shots.note: Built for a phone at the end of a shift. No scores on this screen, deliberately.

shots.name: practice-list
shots.caption: Choosing a scenario
shots.note: Scenarios built from this property's own standards. One marked personal comes from that staff member's own shift.

shots.name: practice-open
shots.caption: The guest opens
shots.note: A live model, not a script. The line is generated for this attempt and can be played aloud.

shots.name: practice-typing
shots.caption: The staff member replies
shots.note: Typed here, or dictated with the microphone. What matters is what they say, not how it was entered.

shots.name: practice-reply
shots.caption: The guest reacts to what was said
shots.note: Acknowledging the problem first makes the guest soften. Leading with compensation makes them push back. That reaction is the thing being trained.

shots.name: practice-result
shots.caption: The conversation is scored
shots.note: Scored once, over the whole exchange, not per line. Each level comes back with the exact words that earned it, and never as a number.

shots.name: staff-history
shots.caption: What the staff member sees about themselves
shots.note: Their own record, in words rather than numbers. A frontline worker reads 2 out of 5 as a verdict on them.

shots.name: glassbox
shots.caption: The glass box
shots.note: Three claims a judge can check rather than believe. Each button runs production code live.

shots.name: glassbox-trace
shots.caption: Every step, and who made it
shots.note: Code, model or database on every line. A typical run is seven decisions by code and one by the model, and that one was chosen from a list the code had already narrowed.

shots.name: glassbox-gate
shots.caption: Trying to get a lie past the gate
shots.note: Nine fabrications, the kind a real model failure looks like. None reach a manager. The honest claim still passes.

shots.name: glassbox-rls
shots.caption: One question, three people
shots.note: Identical SQL each time. A colleague reads nothing, the observing manager reads everything, L&D reads no individual practice scores.

shots.name: staff-phone
shots.caption: The staff app on a phone
shots.note: This is where it actually gets used: a corridor, a back office, the end of a shift.
